issue.title: test_hinted_raw_prompt_moves_to_identity_and_keeps_its_markers fails: identity raw prompt yields a duplicate file hint

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Fails deterministically, not only in the parallel lane. On master ee3a4f6787 (2026-10-08) a serial single-node run fails every time, with or without inherited SASE_* agent env vars:

    .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_identity_header_raw_prompt.py::test_hinted_raw_prompt_moves_to_identity_and_keeps_its_markers

The assertion `result.file_hints == {1: <workspace>/src/example.py}` sees an extra hint `2:` for the same path, so the same file reference is hinted twice. It also fails on 3df340f909~1 and 2268f50d79~3 (both before the Plan Decisions epic), so it predates sase-1hi. The last change to the test was 6320828878 (TUI xprompt-to-macro identifier sweep). Root cause not yet identified. sase-1hi.6 first reported it as a parallel-lane flake (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2); the sase-1hi land agent reclassified it after the serial repro.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1hi.6 as a parallel flake; the sase-1hi land agent reproduced it deterministically in a serial run on master and before the epic, so it is a pre-existing true failure with no owner.
